title: Raspberry Pi HAT for IR Transmission
desc: Project Overview Custom Raspberry Pi HAT (compatible with 3B and 4B models) designed for high-density IR signal transmission and learning. The board acts as a centralized IR bridge, driven by custom Python/Flask software on the Pi. The Pi requires no additional I/O functions beyond this IR management. Hardware Specifications 1. Power Delivery Input: 1x USB-C receptacle on the HAT. Routing: The USB-C port must power the HAT's circuitry and back-power the Raspberry Pi specifically via the 4 pins located near the main GPIO header (the PoE header pins). 2. title: Unlock BitLocker, Recover Small Business Data
desc:
My company-owned laptop is still physically with me, but a former employee encrypted its primary SSD with BitLocker and tied the keys to his personal Microsoft account. The machine runs Windows 11 and will boot all the way into Windows; the problem is that every business-critical volume remains locked, leaving me without access to files that are now central to an internal theft investigation.

I need an experienced security professional who can:

• Bypass or otherwise unlock the existing BitLocker protection without that user’s Microsoft credentials  
• Extract a full, verified copy of all user data (including deleted items)  
• Preserve evidence integrity and provide a concise forensic report that could hold up in potential legal proceedings

You may guide me through software-based techniques, request that I image the drive with tools such as dd, FTK Imager, or EnCase, or propose hardware methods if safer. I am comfortable opening the device, removing the NVMe drive, and following detailed instructions, and I can sign any chain-of-custody documentation you require.

Deliverables I expect:

1. Decrypted disk image or restored access to all partitions  
2. File dump of recovered data in a portable format  
3. Written summary of steps taken, hash values of recovered images, and notable findings for legal review

Payment is results-driven; if you can demonstrate a clear, lawful path to recovering this data, I’m ready to proceed immediately.
